notes: OSF file fr6g8 is the primary SCORE replication report and its title/project ID matches the supplied reference, despite the input citation date differing from the OSF file upload date (2020). Extracted final pooled Stage 2 rather than interim Stage 1. Kept printed log odds ratio and its accompanying Wald p = 0.240 together; the report separately prints a chi-square test with p = 0.239 on p. 5. Original DOI landing page was restricted-access abstract only; Unpaywall and OpenAlex identified the same SSRN accepted manuscript, but SSRN returned 403 and was not retried. Publisher supplemental route also returned 403/challenge. No original statistics were inferred from replication quotations.
